findings.text: the digest is taken from node.brief, the source path, rather than the durable copy at node.brief_path, so change_lane at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:7382 refuses a lane change with "the brief is not readable" once the source scratch file is gone, which is exactly the case _store_brief's own docstring says the run-directory copy exists to survive.

the dispatch-level wiring that carries the brief into the composed prompt has no assertion, so _brief_text returning an empty string would leave all four added tests green while the worker's prompt fell back to a PLAN pointer naming an empty plan slug.

the mutual-exclusion check tests brief_path and plan_slug only, so "--brief ... --section s2" is accepted and the section silently discarded rather than refused as the plan's "--brief as mutually exclusive with --plan / --section" states.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's four bullets each have a named case in tests/test_brief_dispatch.py (dry-run resolution with brief.sha256, a stub-launcher pointer carrying brief.sha256, brief.path and the copied bytes, a missing done-when refused not-dispatchable at exit 2, and --brief with --plan refused), and the manifest records 4 passed EXIT=0 in logs/gate-brief-dispatch.log, which an independent re-run at head 9f6f58b3 reproduced 4/4 (review-rerun-head.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to let dispatch take a stored brief in place of a committed plan section; reckon/cli.py:1060 makes --plan optional and adds --brief, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3171 replaces the committed-section and plan-review gates with the brief's digest, and the copy and digest reach the pointer at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4025 and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4280.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the gate command and result, the negative-control log and its observation, five log paths, and it carries status complete with no wait block.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's nine declared paths; every path in the diff over 3f251453..9f6f58b3 is inside them, and the cumulative evidence record was spliced rather than rewritten, with the section 3 anchor and its own commit list intact at docs/evidence/archive/a-worker-can-take-a-brief-landed.html.

justifications.evidence: logs/gate-brief-dispatch.log names revision dcb66ac8, the tree, reckon.__file__ and cwd, and its 4 passed EXIT=0 is reproduced by an independent 4/4 run at head 9f6f58b3 recorded in review-rerun-head.log.
